description: Route every cam tmux invocation through a dedicated `-L cam` socket so cam never attaches to a stale shared default tmux server.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: -L socket-name selects an independent server socket under /tmp/tmux-<UID>/<name> (or $TMUX_TMPDIR). -L is a global option that must precede the subcommand. `tmux -L cam new-session` starts a fresh independent server if none exists for that socket. -S overrides and ignores -L.

userStories.title: Add CAM_TMUX_SOCKET + tmuxArgs() and thread -L cam through src/tmux/session.ts
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the central tmux helper module to declare a dedicated socket name and a `tmuxArgs()` builder so every downstream call site can prepend `-L cam` consistently, ensuring cam never collides with the user's default tmux server.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tmux/session.ts exports `CAM_TMUX_SOCKET = 'cam'` and `tmuxArgs(sub: string[]): string[]` that returns `['-L', CAM_TMUX_SOCKET, ...sub]`

All five session.ts helpers (`hasSession`, `ensureProjectSession` with its new-session + 2× split-window calls, `openPaneInSession`) invoke tmux via `tmuxArgs([...])` so `-L cam` is the first global flag before the subcommand
`isInsideProjectSession`/`CAM_SESSION` env-based detection is left unchanged (it does not depend on the socket)

test/tmux-session.test.ts is updated to account for the `-L cam` prefix in argv assertions (e.g. previous `args[0] === 'has-session'` becomes `args[2] === 'has-session'` with `args[0] === '-L'`, `args[1] === 'cam'`) and continues to pass
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files: src/tmux/session.ts, test/tmux-session.test.ts. This is the foundation every other story depends on. `-L` is a GLOBAL tmux option and MUST precede the subcommand (`tmux -L cam new-session ...`, never `tmux new-session -L cam`). Out of scope (mention in PR description, not here): src/commands/claude.ts, src/commands/retry-monitor.ts, src/retry/tmux.ts. Stack: Bun + TypeScript + Ink; tests via `bun test`; typecheck via `bun run typecheck`. No travessão in any persisted markdown comment.

userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/run.ts, test/run.test.ts, test/attach-hint.test.ts. Depends on US-001. userStories.title: Thread -L cam through the outside-tmux branch of cam setup
userStories.description: As a cam operator running `cam setup` from outside an existing tmux session, I need the spawned `cam-setup` session to live on the dedicated `-L cam` socket; conversely, when I'm already inside tmux, the setup commands that split MY live interactive window must stay on the ambient socket because they intentionally target the user's current security session, not the cam workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: src/commands/setup.ts outside-tmux branch routes the `cam-setup` `new-session` and its `split-window` through `tmuxArgs([...])` (so the new server is on `-L cam`)

A one-line code comment in setup.ts explains the inside-tmux exception: it splits the user's live interactive window, which lives in the user's current security session, so moving it to `-L cam` would target the wrong server
test/setup-menu.test.ts is updated if it asserts the `cam-setup` argv, and continues to pass

userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/setup.ts, test/setup-menu.test.ts. Depends on US-001. This is the ONLY place where ambient-socket usage is intentional inside the workspace code path. Code comment must be terse and free of travessão (use colon, comma, parens, or period).
